intent: Stop install_new_lg4ff.sh from regenerating the initramfs when the dkms pacman hook has already done it.
changes: Regenerate only when an image carries hid-logitech from the location modprobe no longer resolves to; images without the module, or already matching, are left alone

verification.evidence: rc=0 on the host with new-lg4ff installed (module file updates/dkms/hid-logitech.ko.zst, loaded hid-logitech-new)
empty after the host install: the hook-regenerated image no longer bundles the module, so the conditional path reports 'already matches' instead of a 20 s rebuild

risks: A hand-built initramfs that bundles the in-tree copy is still caught: it lists kernel/drivers/hid/ while modprobe resolves updates/dkms/
rollback: git revert; the unconditional regen returns
